description: Unlock a more intuitive and visually stunning data exploration experience with Pro Filter, the all-in-one Slicer by ChartPad. Designed to replace standard slicers, this versatile filter empowers report creators to build high-performance, user-friendly dashboards that combine navigation, branding, and data insights into a single component. Whether you need a compact Dropdown, a modern Tile/Grid interface, or a complex Hierarchy, Pro Filter by ChartPad delivers unparalleled flexibility for Power BI users. Key Features and Capabilities Pro Filter is engineered to meet the demands of professional report design, offering three distinct display modes and advanced data integration: Three Powerful Modes: Hierarchy Mode: Navigate complex data structures (like Region > State > City) with a clean, expandable tree view. Tile Mode: Create modern, touch-friendly button layouts perfect for high-level categories or landing pages. Dropdown Mode: Save valuable report real-life estate with a sleek, searchable selection menu. Integrated KPI Indicators: Display real-time metrics (e.g., Total Sales, Active Users, or Growth %) directly within the Slicer items to give users instant context before they click.
